title: FIDEL: Abugida-Aware Pre-tokenization for Ethiopic Languages
abstract: arXiv:2611.20216v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Subword tokenizers assume that meaningful linguistic units can be recovered by splitting text at learned boundaries, an assumption better suited to concatenative morphology than to Semitic root-and-pattern systems. The challenge is acute for the Ethiopic languages, whose abugida script encodes consonant-vowel units as single characters and hides consonantal structure. We introduce FIDEL (FId\"al DEcomposition and Linearization), a family of reversible abugida-aware pre-tokenization schemes that expose consonant and vowel-order structure, extend SPLINTER reductions from abjad scripts to the Ethiopic abugida, and evaluate them on three Ethiopic languages under controlled conditions, holding corpus, architecture, budget and protocol fixed so that tokenization is the only variable. translated_title: FIDEL：面向埃塞俄比亚语言的元音附标文字感知预分词方法
translated_abstract: 子词分词器假设有意义的语言单位可以通过在学习到的边界处切分文本来恢复，这一假设更适合黏着型形态，而不太适合闪米特语的词根-词式系统。对于埃塞俄比亚各语言而言，这一挑战尤为严峻，因为它们的元音附标文字将辅音-元音单元编码为单个字符，从而掩盖了辅音结构。我们提出了 FIDEL（FIdäl DEcomposition and Linearization），这是一族可逆的、元音附标文字感知的预分词方案，能够显式揭示辅音和元音顺序结构，并将 SPLINTER 归约方法从辅音音素文字扩展到埃塞俄比亚元音附标文字；我们在受控条件下对三种埃塞俄比亚语言进行评估，保持语料库、架构、预算和协议固定不变，使分词方式成为唯一变量。我们报告了 BPE 和 UnigramLM 在不同词表规模下的分词器内在统计指标，以及下游 NLP 任务的结果（包括迁移场景）。我们发现……
tldr: 本文提出 FIDEL——一族可逆的、感知埃塞俄比亚元音附标文字结构的预分词方案，通过显式揭示辅音与元音顺序结构来改进埃塞俄比亚各语言的分词质量，并在严格控制变量的条件下验证了其对分词统计与下游 NLP 任务的影响。
en_tdlr: FIDEL introduces a family of reversible abugida-aware pre-tokenization schemes that expose consonant and vowel-order structure for Ethiopic languages, with controlled experiments evaluating their impact on tokenizer statistics and downstream NLP tasks.
